title: Have an LLM Write Your Anomaly Detector: Autonomous Discovery of Compact, Interpretable Detectors for Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2610.01223v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection trades off predictive accuracy, computational efficiency, and interpretability. We use a large language model not as the detector but as the author of one: an autonomous research loop in which the model repeatedly edits a single short NumPy program under a leakage-free objective, keeping the best-scoring detector it finds. The loop discovers two compact detectors, one for univariate and one for multivariate series, that describe short windows by their local spectral features and compare them with the training-region distribution through a covariance-aware distance. On the TSB-AD benchmark these detectors lead the field across metrics, ahead of the strongest classical, deep, and foundation-model baselines including Time-RCD, yet they train no network and use no GPU, and the multivariate detector is faster than every similarly performing baseline. translated_title: 让大语言模型为你编写异常检测器：自主发现紧凑且可解释的时间序列检测器
translated_abstract: 时间序列异常检测需要在预测准确性、计算效率和可解释性之间进行权衡。我们使用大语言模型不是作为检测器本身，而是作为检测器的编写者：通过一个自主研究循环，模型在无数据泄露的目标下反复编辑一个简短的NumPy程序，并保留其发现的得分最高的检测器。该循环发现了两个紧凑的检测器，一个针对单变量序列，一个针对多变量序列，它们通过局部频谱特征描述短时间窗口，并通过考虑协方差的距离将其与训练区域的分布进行比较。在TSB-AD基准测试中，这些检测器在各项指标上均领先于该领域，超越了包括Time-RCD在内的最强经典方法、深度学习和基础模型基线，但它们不训练任何网络、不使用GPU，并且多变量检测器比所有性能相当的基线运行速度更快。因此，LLM驱动的程序搜索是一条通往高精度的实用路线。
tldr: 本文提出让大语言模型作为“编写者”而非检测器，通过自主循环在无泄露目标下反复编辑简短的NumPy程序，发现了两个基于局部频谱特征和协方差感知距离的紧凑可解释检测器，在TSB-AD基准上以无需训练网络和使用GPU的方式全面超越经典、深度学习和基础模型基线。
en_tdlr: This paper uses an LLM not as a detector but as its author, employing an autonomous research loop that repeatedly edits a short NumPy program to discover two compact, interpretable time-series anomaly detectors based on local spectral features and covariance-aware distances, which lead the TSB-AD benchmark without training any network or using a GPU.
